reforms.description: Congress enacted a bill encouraging the development of synthetic fuels from various sources, with a government Synthetic Fuels Corporation providing loan and price guarantees to support this initiative.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The initiative aims to reduce dependency on traditional oil imports and foster the development of alternative energy sources, which can enhance energy security and stimulate economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The bill was enacted to support the development of synthetic fuels.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant shift towards alternative energy sources, with potential long-term impacts on energy independence and economic resilience.
reforms.source_quote: Congress enacted a bill encouraging the development of synthetic fuels from coal liquids and gases, oil shale, biomass and unconventional gas in June.
